Where: Athens, 0, Athens, Athens
Source: Meetup — Athens tech · Meetup

CityJS Athens is back this October, from **21–23 October**, bringing together the JavaScript community for **two days of workshops, a community meetup, and a full conference day at the Athens War Museum**. As we enter the AI era, CityJS Athens is evolving too. This year's program will feature more content focused on AI, while continuing to showcase the latest developments, tools, and trends across the JavaScript ecosystem.
